senses.gloss: līna, adj. (= Pali id.; not in this sense in Skt.; for true definition see CPD s.v. alīna, q.v.; wrongly Childers and PTSD), dispirited, faint-hearted: Mvy 〔7269〕 = Tib. zhum pa; 〔850〕 apagata-līna-citta (of Bodhisattvas); Śikṣ 〔20.15〕 līnaṃ cittaṃ bodhisattvānāṃ na saṃvidyate. Cf. 2 līyati.
līna-tā, Śikṣ 〔179.14〕, and ˚tva, nt., 〔180.10〕, abstr. from prec.
